newsitem.title: USA: Wall St stocks higher with bonds in early trading.
newsitem.headline: Wall St stocks higher with bonds in early trading.

text.p: Wall Street stocks bounced at the opening on Wednesday after the previous day's rout which saw the Dow shed its 100-point gain and close lower.
The stock market received a boost from bonds, which ticked higher on favourable economic data.
The Dow Industrials were up 16 at 6672. The Nasdaq Composite was up five at 1359.
Tthe Commerce Department said on Wednesda that orders for costly manufactured goods dropped unexpectedly in December, primarily because of a steep decline in demand for communications equipment.
